name: poiesis-insight
description: Interpret research and data: insights, research questions and the methods of a field, each conclusion with its evidence, rivals and a recorded challenge.

plugins.name: poiesis-insight
plugins.description: Insights (connections, contradictions, counted patterns), research questions from gaps in the evidence, and the methods of a field, from a project's research or data. Every conclusion carries its evidence, rivals and what would prove it wrong, passes a challenge, and has its verdict recorded once with a stamp. Agents: insight-analyst, challenger. Foresight is in poiesis-foresight.
